translations.web: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
translations.bsb: “Behold, I am insignificant. How can I reply to You? I place my hand over my mouth.
translations.kjv: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
